name: Customize - Clean Public Desktop Shortcuts
description: Removes unapproved shortcut files from the Windows Public Desktop while preserving an editable list of shortcut names.

options.name: content
options.description: Content item containing the Clear-PublicDesktopShortcuts.ps1 script

options.name: scriptName
options.description: Name of the PowerShell script inside the content item

options.name: ShortcutsToKeep
options.description: Enter one shortcut filename per line. Extensions are optional. A blank list removes every .lnk and .url shortcut from the Public Desktop.

options.name: DisableEdgeDesktopShortcutCreation
options.displayName: Disable Microsoft Edge desktop shortcut creation
options.description: Sets the Microsoft Edge DesktopShortcutCreationEnabled machine policy to 0 so Edge does not create desktop shortcuts.
